method: Five complete pinned files read and blobs verified. Original file helper functions AST-extracted, original IO module loaded; display controls only owned temp empty/missing paths, remove entirely mocked.
findings: display_file mmap length0 on empty file raises ValueError before empty marker path; only EnvironmentError caught. Original-function control confirms unhandled empty-file exception.
display_file exception handler refers to terminal.termwrap although only termwrap imported. Missing owned temp path triggers NameError masking initial filesystem error.

remove_sources_files continues to .save companion even when primary remove raises PermissionError. Mock control confirms both removal attempts and status1/primarycount0. No filesystem deletion executed.
Doc says companion failures disregarded, but code sets rv1 for nonENOENT companion failure. Main counters count primary only; status and count semantics differ.

FileDescriptor context closes fd and release transfers ownership explicitly. No destructor cleanup if not used/closed; close failure leaves _fd set. TextIO replacement detaches old wrapper after constructing new; caller ownership changes.

EquivalenceRelation validates overlapping classes via __debug__ assertions only. Optimized launcher -O disables overlap checks; conflicting scheme classes can yield ambiguous representative selection. No fullCLI proof yet.

OrderedFrozenset retains dict order and index preference; duplicate input items overwrite their last positional index. IndexedEquivalenceRelation creates index from classes; initialization behavior not executed in this turn.
Collection helpers backport protocol checks; ExtSet methods return mutation booleans used by discard_first_of. These utilities do not compare file bytes.

result.scope: Original functions; display only owned empty/missing temporary paths. Removal fully mocked; no APT/system configuration accessed.

limits: No APT parser/fullCLI/system configuration or production changes. Deletion mocked. Native pHash/ASAN deferred.
